title: Chapter 734
paragraphs: Chapter 734
Episode 184. Beyond Destiny (6)
It's deep.
Even the tunnels in the Imperial City were shallow compared to this cliff.
Jin had been descending for several minutes, and as he approached the ground, he felt two sensations simultaneously.
The first was an aura that pierced his body like a knife, and the second was the sensation of his aura generation organ being blocked.
It was as if he was exposed to the 'Aura Interferer' made by Qwaul and Valeria.
Just before landing, Jin gently stepped on the ground, offsetting the impact with his sword energy.
He was also engulfed by one intuition. This place would just be the '1st basement floor'.
'Rosa would certainly be on the lowest floor, no matter how many floors there are.'
Looking around, he saw the lights of eye glows in the distance.
Jin immediately recognized that nearly twenty of those lights were eye glows.
The fierce hostility emanating from those eyes was visibly palpable.
"I hope this time..."
Jin's low voice spread through the empty space like the wind. Again, it was a completely different energy from the knights that had come out of the crypt until now.
"I wish it would be someone who qualifies to be called my ancestor."
The eye glow was gradually approaching. Jin also moved towards them.
'Eleven people?'
That the twenty-two eyes were all eye glows meant that they were all knights who had returned from the crypt.
As the distance closed, the knights' outlines were revealed.
Looking at their attire, Jin recognized that they were a feudal lord and ten black knights.
However, unlike the black knights, the knight presumed to be the feudal lord looked a bit different from the lords he had encountered before.
'Is his face covered with chains?'

Black chains were wrapped around his face. The sword he held was also a normal long sword, the most commonly used weapon by the previous feudal lords, so it was impossible to identify his identity from his weapon.
"I'm Jin Runcandel of the 12th flagbearer. Knights, reveal your names."
In response to his words, a black knight, not the feudal lord, opened his mouth.
[You came down alone.]
"So you're the captain of the black knights, the feudal lord can't speak?"
The chains binding the lord's face seemed to twitch a bit.
"In that case, I'll hold off on taking the lord's life for now. Everyone, come in."
Jin, pointing his sword obliquely towards the knights.
He was in a state where the stifling sensation, as if his aura generation organ and blood vessels were blocked, had intensified.
On the other hand, the knights of the crypt were not affected at all.
The knights knew that fact very well.
Nevertheless, they deployed their formation carefully.
Even if their aura generation organs were tied up, they never lost the recognition that Jin was not an opponent to be underestimated.
"If it's too much for you, I'll go first."
Boom-!
The ground where Jin was standing exploded, and a sharp cracking sound was made.
The first thing his sword targeted was the feudal lord's face, trying to cut off the chains covering it.
But the lord deflected the blow by lifting his sword, and the swords of the black knights flew at Jin from all sides.
Rotating and pushing away two blades, Jin slipped through the gap and thrust his blade back into the lord's face.
Ting-!
A chain was caught on the tip of the sword, and a fragment sprang out.
Following that, a light-speed thrust opened by the lord retreating behind the black knights grazed Jin's ear.
A hot stream of blood flowed from his ear, but Jin was wrapped in a question, not a sense of crisis.
'I can't feel the sharpness or killing intent from the lord's sword.'
The killing intent that stingingly pierced the skin was all due to the black knights. In other words, the lord did not have the will to kill Jin.
'But every attack is clearly fatal...'
The lord is being controlled.
Jin considered that situation. Someone is moving the lord's body like a puppet.
Of course, it could only be Rosa.
This time, a black knight's sword grazed Jin's shoulder. Small wounds were starting to appear one by one, but Jin didn't lose his composure.
The aura generation interference must have been carried out through Rosa's aura.
While he couldn't immediately find and destroy the device or link that realized it, it wasn't a problem for Jin.
'I did well to come down alone. Rosa's use of aura generation interference is to kill other people more easily, not me.'
Fundamentally, if it doesn't completely destroy the aura organ, such interference will only temporarily inconvenience Jin.
Kaaah-!
When Jin let out a shout, a shockwave spread with a flash of light.
Three black knights rushing in due to the aftermath were pushed away, and the lord who was at their center stumbled back.
The blood vessels that had been blocked all the while were opening.
The reason why Jin didn't undo the aura interference from the beginning was purely due to questions about the behavior of the lord and Rosa.
"Building a castle, digging underground, blocking the mouths of the old lords, using tricks like aura interference... It's not fitting for a blasphemer to do such things."
The blade of Bradamante pointed to the sky, holding a white light.
Runcandel's 3rd Tactical Battle Command, Meteor Shower.
Sword energy formed in the void rained down on the underground like a tidal wave.
The black knights lowered their stance and spread their sword energy to intercept the Meteor Shower, and in that moment of opportunity, Jin once again penetrated their formation.
Squeak-!
With the fall of a Black Knight's right arm, the melee battle truly began. The swords of one and eleven mixed together, endlessly leaving intricate trails in the darkness.
In the midst of this, the Meteor Shower did not stop, continuously striking the battlefield.
Every time a lump of sword energy fell, the terrain changed, and the Black Knights were always one step behind Jin in terms of movement.
Only the master, with his violet eyes, was reading the ever-changing battlefield at a pace almost equal to Jin's.
There was still no sign of killing intent in his eyes.
On the contrary, he seemed to be harboring some sort of desperate outcry.
Clearly, he didn't want this fight.
"This swordsmanship is not yours."
Except for the ultimate moves of the Runcandel sword, it had no special form.
However, Jin could read a familiar flow in the master's swordsmanship.
The flow of a man who wielded his sword wildly, more like a Runcandel than anyone, even without a Runcandel's body.
"Are you feeling nostalgic for your human days? Monster."
The master's swordsmanship was exactly in line with Rosa's.
It was Rosa who was controlling him.
There was only one reason why Rosa would 'control' him.
'The former master is standing against it, to the monster.'
Jin saw a hint of bitterness in him, but also a sliver of hope for the Runcandel family.
'Not all the knights from the tomb are completely obedient to Rosa. Like this master, there are those who oppose the monster's will.'
The master had not said a word, and had always swung his sword to kill Jin without fail.
But Jin read one thing in him that he never let go of, a Runcandel's mindset.
Struggle, unyielding even against the will of the gods.
In the long, long thousand-year history of Runcandel.
There cannot be only one such character left.
If there are those who have succumbed to evil, like Lionel or Senga, there must also be those who never fall. Like the former master, who is burning his will more desperately than when he was alive.
Only then did Jin realize Rosa's intention.
'Showing that even the ancestors who stand against her to the end are ultimately helpless, she wants me to kill all such people.'
Not only Rosa, but also the master who was mixing his sword with Jin's, was hoping for his own death.
Because the only way out of the humiliation of becoming a puppet is death itself.
Even if they could not liberate their souls after death and had to endure eternal torture, it was better than becoming a puppet fighting for the monster.
Even if their minds eventually broke under the torture and they completely vanished from this world. It was better than fighting for the one who defiles the family.
Jin had no intention of complying with such a heinous intention from Rosa.
"I'll set you free soon, ancestor."
Jin's attitude toward the master changed.
His thrusting sword became more fierce towards him, but that was only to break the chains binding him as quickly as possible.
However, the Black Knights were tenaciously biting at Jin.
To fight with the Mwangunrim sword or similar ultimate moves, he could not preserve the master's body.
Of course, even if he breaks the master's bond, there's no guarantee that Rosa won't take his soul or life from him.
But Jin wanted to talk with him, even if for a moment, once he had freed him from his chains.
He wanted to tell his ancestor that he fought honorably to the end.
And if possible, he wanted to save him and hack through this hell together.
Cough!
A chain that was wrapped around the master's face was cut off.
His eyes were slightly more clearly exposed.
At the same time, blood splattered from Jin's shoulder.
It was the blade of the Black Knight's captain.
Although it hadn't penetrated deeply, if the bleeding continued to accumulate like this, even Jin would inevitably become a bit sluggish in his movements.
However, there were comrades jumping from the upper levels to the underground.
"Jin!"
He could hear Hedo's voice.
Along with him, Bianca and Octavia were descending toward the battlefield.
Ten minutes had passed.
Even without them, the situation was in Jin's favor, so the knights from the tomb had no choice but to face a tougher battle.
Hedo's swordsmanship and Octavia's light magic overwhelmed the Black Knights.
The two of them, who had been on the same side until a while ago, showed a great harmony.
Bianca took a position behind Jin while the Black Knights were startled. As a result, the Black Knight's captain had to block Bianca's greatsword with the sword he was going to stab Jin with.
For a moment, Jin had time to focus entirely on the master.
Jin expected the fight to be somewhat prolonged, as Rosa was directly controlling him.
However, the moment Jin swung his sword at the chains, the master momentarily released Rosa's control.
His sword, which was moving to block Bradamante, paused for a moment.
'Did I manage to break a few strands of the chain?'
That was the best and greatest outcome that the master could achieve by resisting the control, and Jin didn't miss the opportunity.
Swoosh, clang-!
Finally, in a single blow, Jin was able to cut off the chain that had been covering the master's face.
The face of the exposed master was that of a person Jin had heard about many times while studying the history of Runcandel in his previous life.
Alphen Runcandel.
He was the 20th master of Runcandel, formerly known as the 'Knight of Light'.
